note: THE DEGENERATE REGION, which is `(s-word-wrap N "")'. Emacs answers (nil ""): an empty region fills to nothing and the return value is NIL rather than the empty string the filled cases give, so `fill-region''s value is `the prefix of the last paragraph it filled' and there was none. A binding that always answered "" would pass every other case in this row and fail this one. kg answers `void-function' at this pin.
